problem_statement: The Windmill Dashboard admin template hosts an "Account status filter" toolbar directly above its accounts data table on the Dashboard and Tables pages. The toolbar is a real, native control: a row of status segments (All / Approved / Pending / Denied / Expired) with a live result readout ("Showing N of 10 · Status"); clicking a segment filters the ten account rows to that status and updates the count. Three regressions have been reported and must be repaired together. (1) Responsive overflow: the segment row is laid out as a fixed-width (760px) non-wrapping flex track, so on the 390px mobile and 834px tablet Dashboard the segments run off the right edge and the whole page scrolls horizontally (~430px of overflow); the row must reflow to fit narrow viewports with no horizontal page overflow. (2) Cross-page continuity: the filter toolbar is only present on the Dashboard; it must also appear above the accounts table on the Tables page and as a filter surface on the Forms page, so the same status-filter control is reachable everywhere the accounts data appears. (3) Filter wiring and legibility: clicking a status segment must recompute and show the live "Showing N of 10 · Status" readout and keep the account rows laid out as a clean, legible, non-overlapping table with a readable active-segment style. Preserve the Windmill design language, the ten account rows and their status pills, the shared navigation, header, search, KPI cards, charts, dark-theme shell and desktop layout. Do not delete rows, hide the toolbar, or mask overflow with overflow:hidden.
required_content: The Account status filter toolbar (All / Approved / Pending / Denied / Expired segments plus the live "Showing N of 10 · Status" readout) renders within the viewport at 390px mobile and 834px tablet on the Dashboard with no horizontal page overflow beyond a small tolerance.
The same filter toolbar is present above the accounts table on the Tables page and as a filter surface on the Forms page, not only on the Dashboard.
Clicking a status segment filters the ten account rows to that status and updates the readout to the correct live count and label (e.g. "Showing 2 of 10 · Pending").

The accounts table renders as a clean, legible, non-overlapping row layout with a readable active-segment style; the Windmill navigation, header/search, KPI cards, charts and dark-theme shell remain visually unchanged on desktop.
The desktop Dashboard and Tables layout of the toolbar (a single tidy row of segments at wide widths) and the ten account rows with their status pills are preserved.
design_constraints: Preserve the Windmill design language: purple accent, white/gray-800 cards, rounded-lg shadow-xs surfaces, Inter/system type, and the fixed-sidebar admin shell.
Lay out the segment row so it reflows on narrow viewports (wrap / fluid basis); do not remove segments, hide the toolbar, or mask overflow with overflow:hidden.
Keep the accounts table rows in a clean, non-overlapping, legible layout and the active segment readable (adequate contrast); do not collapse or shingle the rows.
The filter toolbar must be reachable on the Dashboard, the Tables page and the Forms page; the status-filter control markup stays identical across pages and viewports.
Clicking a segment must recompute the visible-row count and the readout label live; the readout must reflect the actual filtered rows, not a stale snapshot.
state_constraints: desktop_dashboard captures the Dashboard at 1440px with the filter toolbar as one tidy segment row above a clean ten-row accounts table and the readout "Showing 10 of 10 · All".
desktop_dashboard_filter_pending captures the Dashboard after clicking the Pending segment; the table shows only Pending rows and the readout reads "Showing 2 of 10 · Pending".
mobile_dashboard captures the Dashboard at 390px; in a buggy build the fixed-width non-wrapping segment row overflows and the page scrolls horizontally.
tablet_dashboard captures the Dashboard at 834px where the same fixed-width segment row overflows.
desktop_tables captures the Tables page at 1440px with the filter toolbar above the accounts table as one clean row.
mobile_tables captures the Tables page at 390px where the toolbar segment row overflows when present.
desktop_forms captures the Forms page at 1440px, which must also carry the filter surface.
desktop_charts_route captures the Charts page at 1440px as an unaffected cross-page anchor.

Source inspection confirms the toolbar is a static section (id acct-filter) inserted above the accounts table, styled by assets/css/acct-filter.css and wired by assets/js/acct-filter.js; the surrounding Windmill shell, nav, cards, charts and forms are otherwise untouched.

change_completion: The Account status filter toolbar fits within the 390px mobile and 834px tablet viewport on the Dashboard with no horizontal page overflow.
Clicking a status segment filters the account rows and updates the live readout to the correct count and label.
The toolbar is present on the Dashboard, Tables and Forms pages.
design_consistency: The repair preserves the Windmill purple/card visual language and the desktop single-row layout of the segment toolbar.
The accounts table stays a clean, legible, non-overlapping row layout with a readable active segment; navigation, KPI cards, charts and dark-theme shell are visually unchanged.
responsive: At 390px mobile the segment row reflows within the viewport with no horizontal page overflow.
At 834px tablet the segment row reflows within the viewport with no horizontal page overflow.
regression: The Windmill navigation, header, search, KPI cards, data tables, charts and dark-theme shell remain reachable and visually unchanged on desktop after the repair.
The ten account rows, their status pills and the shared shell are preserved on every page.

metadata.design_goal: repair the dashboard's own native table filter so the ops state (which accounts, filtered by status) stays consistent across the click and across pages
metadata.source_repo_kind: Static Tailwind + Alpine admin dashboard (Windmill) with a fixed sidebar shell, KPI cards, Chart.js charts, and accounts data tables on the Dashboard, Tables and Forms pages.
metadata.selected_repo_reason: technext/windmill-dashboard is a runnable static admin dashboard; it serves offline and hosts a natural state-continuity regression on the dashboard's OWN accounts-table status filter spanning a mobile/tablet overflow defect, cross-page toolbar presence, filtered-table layout, and segment-click count wiring.

author_notes: L5 regression/state-continuity task on the technext Windmill admin dashboard, built so the lever is the dashboard's OWN accounts data table and its native 'Account status filter' toolbar (All / Approved / Pending / Denied / Expired over ten real account rows with a live 'Showing N of 10 · Status' count), hardened to fail four orthogonal acceptance gates in the bad solution. Lever 1 (D6 no_horizontal_overflow): the segment row uses a fixed-width non-wrapping track that overflows the 390px mobile and 834px tablet viewport; the reference wraps it with a fluid basis. Lever 2 (D2 dom_assertions, cross-page): the filter toolbar must be present above the accounts table on the Dashboard, the Tables page and the Forms page; the reference promotes it on all three, the baseline only on the Dashboard, the bad on Dashboard and Tables (forgetting Forms). Lever 3 (D3 visual_regression): the bad solution collapses the accounts table into shingled, overlapping rows with negative margins and renders the active segment as near-white text on a near-white background (illegible), while the reference keeps a clean, legible table. Lever 4 (D4 interaction_assertions): clicking the Pending segment must recompute the readout to 'Showing 2 of 10 · Pending'; the bad solution snapshots the readout string at init and never recomputes it, so the click registers and rows hide but the count stays frozen at 'Showing 10 of 10 · All'. The captured accounts table uses local avatar image assets under assets/img. Distinct from slot_261 on the same repo, whose lever is an Operations focus-mode panel switcher on the Dashboard only.
